A1.justification: Both complete 32-page PDFs describe the same ALGD research. Their text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–F support reliable comparison; all appendix pages are visually identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original safe reinforcement learning experiments in Section 4, with benchmark comparisons, ablations and runtime measurements in Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark experiments, ablations and runtime measurements in Section 4 and Appendix F.

M1.justification: ALGD's augmented-Lagrangian guidance, ensemble cost critics, Monte Carlo score estimation and policy sampling remain unchanged, including Algorithm 1 in Appendix E.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Safety-Gym and velocity-constrained MuJoCo tasks and retain the differential-drive robot landscape experiment (Figures 1, 3 and 5; Appendix F.1).

E2.justification: Figure 3 retains SAC+Lag, SAC+AugLag, HJ and CAL; Figure 6 retains PPO+Lag. The standard-Lagrangian comparator in Figures 2 and 10 is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Task modifications, evaluation metrics, training budgets, network configurations and hyperparameters are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices F.1–F.3.

E4.justification: Both retain the same energy-landscape and training-stability analyses and ablations of Monte Carlo sample count, critic ensemble size and convexification strength (Figures 1–2, 4 and 7–10).

E5.justification: Table 4 retains ten seeds. Mean±standard-deviation reporting in Tables 2, 5 and 6 and the plotted uncertainty displays are unchanged.

E6.justification: Benchmark curves, ablation outcomes and runtime values are identical. No result entries, rankings or reported findings are added, removed or revised.

T1.justification: The propositions, theorems, assumptions and Appendix C–D derivations are unchanged. In Theorem 3.2(b), a comma moves outside an expectation's closing bracket; this corrects punctuation without changing mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about stabilized diffusion and primal-dual training, preservation of the optimal policy distribution, and competitive rewards with lower constraint costs.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and result interpretations are unchanged. Appendix B retains the limitations concerning coupled-learning convergence guarantees and evaluation restricted to simulated environments.

D1.justification: Implementation instructions, architecture and hyperparameter tables, and runtime disclosures are unchanged. The project link moves from the title area into the abstract but retains the same destination and access information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning in the introduction, Appendix A and bibliography are unchanged. The revised proceedings footer is document metadata, not a change in positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds project-page wording at the abstract's end, replaces the preprint footer with ICML proceedings/copyright text, and corrects equation punctuation. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The relocated project link and revised footer alter the first-page layout, moving the introduction's opening to the right column and reflowing text across pages 1–3. Figures and tables retain their content and presentation.

improvement.justification: v2 provides limited formatting and punctuation cleanup while preserving the same methods, proofs, empirical evidence, limitations and reproducibility information, including all appendices. These cosmetic changes do not materially improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
